lines.text: Every January, Jen promised herself she would hike more.
By March, her boots were back in the closet.
The goal was fine. She just had no plan.
So this year, she printed one and put it on the fridge.
One hike a week, a trail picked for every month, long weekends already marked.
After every hike, she colored in the miles.
By December, the whole page was full.
Save this before you set next year's goals.
